meta_description:
4,305 likes, 54 comments - earthpix on October 20, 2026: "What if your dinner menu was decided by tarot cards? 🔮🍽️ At Merlin’s in Ubud, Bali, guests draw cards that guide their food and drink choices, turning a restaurant visit into a unique, interactive experience.⁠
⁠
Beyond the mystical concept, the restaurant serves creative dishes with thoughtful presentation, proving that the experience is about more than just the surprise of not knowing what’s coming next. ⁠
⁠
Would you let the cards choose your entire meal?⁠
🎥: @twosolesabroad".
